name: Gluten
description: Cereals containing gluten: wheat (including spelt), rye, barley, oats and their products.

name: Crustaceans
description: Shrimps, prawns, crabs, lobsters, crayfish and their products.

name: Eggs
description: Eggs and products made with them, including mayonnaise, pasta and many baked goods.

name: Fish
description: All fish and fish products, including fish sauce and anchovies.

name: Peanuts
description: Peanuts and their products, including peanut butter, peanut oil and peanut flour.

name: Soybeans
description: Soybeans and their products, including tofu, tempeh, soy milk and soy sauce.

name: Milk
description: Milk protein from cows, goats and sheep and dairy products made from it.

name: Tree nuts
description: Almonds, hazelnuts, walnuts, cashews, pecans, Brazil nuts, pistachios, macadamia nuts and their products.

name: Celery
description: Celery stalks, leaves, seeds and celeriac, including celery salt and many stocks.

name: Mustard
description: Mustard seeds, powder, leaves and prepared mustard, including dressings and marinades.

name: Sesame
description: Sesame seeds and their products, including tahini, sesame oil and hummus.

name: Sulphites
description: Sulphur dioxide and sulphites above 10 mg/kg, used in dried fruit, wine and some processed foods.

name: Lupin
description: Lupin seeds and flour, used in some breads, pastries and gluten-free products.

name: Molluscs
description: Mussels, oysters, clams, squid, octopus, snails and their products.

name: Lactose
description: Milk sugar; for lactose intolerance, not a milk allergy. Present in most dairy unless lactose-free.
